3026.name: DL_Metro
3026.description: A subway train with a variable number of wagons.

param_0.name: Number of trains
param_0.description: Number of wagons. The locomotive has a boost panel at the front.

param_4.name: First respawn delay
param_4.description: The duration after which the train respawns in its starting position. The train will respawn at path point 0 of its assigned rail path when the timer ends, even if it's still moving on its path. If 0, the train doesn't respawn. For path-loops this means it keeps going.

param_5.name: Consecutive respawn delay
param_5.description: Identical to the previous parameter, but instead for every respawn after the first.
